# Talksign

> Talksign is an artificial intelligence research and product company building AI infrastructure for sign language translation. Talksign turns speech into sign and sign into speech, on smart glasses, phones and computers. Its goal: no one should be left out of a conversation.

Talksign Ltd was founded in London in November 2025. It builds sign language AI with Deaf communities, not just for them. Talksign is backed by NVIDIA and Wild & Mild.

## Products and models
- Talksign-1: Talksign's first model, launched February 2026.
- Palm: sign to speech. Palm 1.0 launched May 2026; Palm 2.0 in November 2026.
- Echo: speech to sign, with photorealistic avatars. Echo 1.0 launched May 2026; Echo 2.0 in November 2026.
- Morph: turns one signing video into a new signing video. Morph 1.0 launched October 2026.
- Languages: American Sign Language (ASL) translation is live. Other sign languages are in development.

## Talksign Marketplace
A marketplace for sign language data. People fluent in sign language earn by recording signing videos; AI teams, research labs and universities license consented, Deaf-reviewed, quality-controlled datasets. Every dataset carries a certificate anyone can check.

## Insights (articles)
- [Why Captions Aren't Enough for Deaf People](https://www.talksign.co/blog/why-captions-arent-enough) (3 Sep 2026, Community): We often think language is just words. But for Deaf people, communication is much more than that. AI needs to understand this difference to truly help everyone.
- [Introducing the Talksign Marketplace](https://www.talksign.co/blog/introducing-the-talksign-marketplace) (25 Aug 2026, Product): A marketplace for licensable multimodal sign language datasets.
- [Introducing Palm 1.0](https://www.talksign.co/blog/introducing-palm-1-0) (22 May 2026, Research): Palm 1.0 reads continuous ASL signing and turns it into English text and speech, clearing the production threshold for translation quality.
- [Introducing Echo 1.0](https://www.talksign.co/blog/introducing-echo-1-0) (22 May 2026, Research): Echo 1.0 turns spoken or written English into photorealistic ASL video at 30 frames per second, signed by a digital human you can choose.
- [Introducing Talksign-1](https://www.talksign.co/blog/introducing-talksign-1) (16 Feb 2026, Research): Breaking down communication barriers with our first-generation AI model for real-time Sign Language recognition

Full text of every article: https://www.talksign.co/llms-full.txt
